text:
alice: @security — got an email from 'payments@acmeco.com' asking me to 'Approve invoice' for $9,800. Link goes to https://accounts.redwood-payments.com/sign?id=384 but sender domain doesn't match. I did NOT click. Uploaded the .eml to the phish queue.

phish-bot: New phish report received (id: 1749991122). Message queued for sandbox analysis.

jordan: @alice thanks for reporting, good call not to click. Can you confirm full headers or that the .eml is in /phish-uploads/ so we can triage?

alice: .eml uploaded to /phish-uploads/1749991122.eml :white_check_mark: headers included in the upload.

sre_oncall: Sandbox finished: /sandbox/results/1749991122.txt
Summary: attached file 'invoice.docm' contains obfuscated VBA macros (AutoOpen). Macro drops a secondary payload and performs HTTP callback to badbox[.]ru and attempts to run powershell -Enc. Quick YARA: TROJ_MACRO_01 matched. Verdict: malicious (score 0.97).

jordan: Blocking badbox[.]ru and related IPs on edge/WAF now. @payments-team please confirm there are no active webhooks or API keys that might have been exposed from any clicks. Also check payment provider webhooks for any unexpected deliveries.

marco: Good catch. I'll trigger forced SSO re-auth for anyone who clicked (we'll need click telemetry). Also start rotation for any ephemeral tokens that could be affected.

lina: I'll draft a targeted note to Finance + Eng with IOC and safe steps (don't click, report, change password if you clicked). Will post draft in #all-hands for review in ~30m.

jordan: Action items: 1) Block domain/IPs (edge/nets) — done/ongoing. 2) Denylist sending domain at our inbound filter + check SPF/DKIM/DMARC. 3) Pull clicker list and force reauth for clicked accounts. 4) Scan for suspicious outbound traffic from user hosts. 5) Add sample to training corpus and schedule a short follow-up awareness. Assigning to @lina and @payments-team for comms and webhook checks.

alice: thanks — let me know if you need the original headers pasted in thread.

phish-bot: Automated note: sample uploaded to malware lab (sample id ml-1749991122).

jordan: We'll close this thread after comms and webhook verification. Leaving a follow-up ticket for post-incident review and mitigation: track: PHISH-2026-034.

marco: Post-incident tasks also include updating the inbound filter rule to treat similar anomalies as high confidence, and a short runbook update for handling payment-themed phish.

lina: Draft posted in #all-hands (link) — ready for edits.

jordan: :thumbsup: closing once tickets are green.
